# Rule: Exported template default changed

_Canonical rule slug:_ `exported-template-default-changed`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A default template argument changes for a template whose instantiation the library exports. The default-substituted symbol changes (BREAKING, default_template_arg_changed), and the header-level kind is recorded as DEDUPLICATED rather than reported twice.
